rubric_items.reason: Every story AC (S-1..S-5, S-7) has an API test, and the job, page and list changes are tested. The server.ts start/stop wiring (CO-6) has no test, and the patient page is checked only through the API.
The assertions check observable results: status, startsAt, history events and actor, HTTP codes, field errors, filter totals, badge class and the exact fetch URLs.

Covers the 24h boundary at -1 min, exactly 24h and +1 min, plus re-staling after a reschedule and an idempotent second run. Error paths: 400/404/409 on close and reschedule, job failure logging, a failed list fetch and a refused close in the UI.
API tests use Vitest+Supertest on a fresh DB with a fixed clock and skipIf(!pgAvailable()). Web tests use jsdom and Testing Library, in the layout's folders. One test name lacks its REQ id.
The artifact reports no test counts or coverage and defers to the verifier. checks.json shows test passed and coverage skipped (exit 78).

findings.text: One test name has no REQ id. The artifact says every test name starts with HMS-34 and its REQ id, and the strategy asks for names that start with the requirement ID.

cites.quote: it('HMS-34 edge: a Completed appointment is still closed, with no actions'
Every test name starts with HMS-34 and its REQ id (C4).

findings.suggested_fix: Rename it to 'HMS-34 REQ-7 edge: ...', or drop the claim that every name carries a REQ id.

findings.text: impl changed server.ts to start the job after listen and stop it on shutdown (CO-6). No test covers that wiring. The timer tests call startStaleJob directly.

cites.quote: api/src/server.ts: CO-6, starts the job after listen from app.locals.ctx and stops it in shutdown.
REQ-1: startStaleJob runs at start and then every hour, as actor system (C7), and the stop function ends the runs.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a test that the server start path calls startStaleJob and that shutdown calls the returned stop function, or state in the artifact why this is left untested.

findings.text: The ut diff's base_sha is not the head_sha impl recorded. The tests were written against a commit that impl.md does not describe, and the artifact does not explain the gap.

cites.quote: base_sha: 5c75aad92008432fe2b1015de9d0afad8a90948b

findings.suggested_fix: Say what changed between b3fff0d and 5c75aad, or confirm it holds no production change outside impl.md.
